Chapter 1443 - 15: Time Lord

Chapter 1443 - 15: Time Lord

Refining a top-tier dimensional space brings numerous benefits, starting with the protection of this top-tier dimensional space.

Any attacks, even from a Legendary Lord like Lord Wanwei, are weakened by ninety-nine percent after being obstructed by the top-tier dimensional space.

A top-tier dimensional space like the Chaos Void is only comparable to a Time Lord in size, but it is shrouded in the supreme rule of the endless dimensional rules and can be considered the strongest means of self-preservation.

Of course, the prerequisite for refining a top-tier dimensional space is to become a lord during a grand destruction cycle.

Another prerequisite is that life must be born naturally in this dimensional space; those time life forms or lords who integrate themselves at great cost are not considered.

Time life forms or lords who forcibly integrate will be rejected by the entire dimensional space, and even if they regain the strength of a lord, they cannot succeed in refining it.

Since the birth of the endless dimensional realms, Lin Yuan is estimated to be the first life to become a lord within a top-tier dimensional space during a grand destruction cycle, as it was never heard before that dimensional spaces could be refined.

Even Lord Wanwei has not left any relevant information, and other Legendary Lords have never heard of such things.

...

"The other source worlds cannot be refined..."

Lin Yuan thought secretly, compared to normal top-tier dimensional spaces, the source worlds are much more special.

Lin Yuan was not surprised by this. The three Immortal Emperors, including the Three-Life Immortal Emperor in the third source world, also became lords during a grand destruction cycle by using the special nature of the source world and still did not refine it.

"The third source world, because of the fall of the illusory world, can no longer be considered a typical source world, existing for far more than one grand destruction cycle."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This also highlights the special nature of the source worlds.

"Let it be, first refine the Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan's mind stirred slightly, beginning to refine the entire Chaos Void.

His inner universe now has surpassed the Chaos Void both in volume and size, but ultimately it was not nurtured by the awareness of the supreme rule, lacking some special charm.

The most obvious difference is that the Chaos Void could nurture time life forms one after another.

However, Lin Yuan's inner universe cannot nurture true time life forms; the spirit of the 'Magic Origin Fruit Tree' trapped in a time cycle is also not nurtured by the inner universe but comes from the vast dimensional gap.

Refining the Chaos Void benefits Lin Yuan in perfecting his inner universe on a microscopic level.

...

Rumble——

As Lin Yuan began refining, the entire Chaos Void was naturally affected.

Countless Great Daos, even the Origin Daos, began to tremble, and time life forms like Lord Mo Xu sensed the commotion and showed up to investigate.

"What happened?"

"Why does it feel like the aura of the Chaos Void is changing?"

Lord Mo Xu and other time life forms were extremely shocked.

Suddenly.

A message entered the minds of all time life forms.

"I have crossed into the Third Realm, refining the Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan's voice came.

Relieving the unease in the hearts of Lord Mo Xu and other time life forms.

Yet, what followed was even greater astonishment.

"The Third Realm? The Milky Way has become a lord?"

The time life form 'Zhu Yin' said in a daze.

Time life forms are divided into three realms, and the Third Realm is called a Time Lord.

"Unbelievable."

Another time life form exclaimed, even though they saw the limitless potential in Lin Yuan, they didn't expect him to become a Time Lord so quickly? How long has it been since he stepped into the thirteenth tier?

"The Milky Way..."

The newly advanced time life form 'Luo Hou' was somewhat dumbfounded.

With Lin Yuan's permission, he had meditated for tens of thousands of years in the Milky Way dimension, thinking he had narrowed the gap with Lin Yuan, only to realize he had already become a lord?

"I entered the thirteenth tier before the 'Milky Way'..."

The newly advanced time life form 'Luo Hou' sighed.

"You just came in ahead of him, we've all been here for more than half a grand destruction cycle."

Other time life forms rolled their eyes.

What all the time life forms didn't know was that although Lin Yuan has just transitioned into the Third Realm and reached the domain of a lord, his actual combat strength is above ninety-nine percent of lords, even among Legendary Lords, he's considered powerful.

Never having experienced any 'Endless Tribulations', yet possessing such power, is unprecedented.

"The Milky Way refined the Chaos Void, so even if a grand destruction cycle occurs, we don't have to leave."

Lord Mo Xu said softly, and in the message Lin Yuan sent to their minds, he briefly introduced the benefits of refining the Chaos Void.

After refining the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan is the true master of the Chaos Void, and if he wishes, even if they are not time life forms nurtured by the Chaos Void, they can also be allowed to enter.

After Lin Yuan completely refined the Chaos Void, he gained insight into many of the essences of this top-tier dimensional space, and with his own accumulations, many bottlenecks that trapped him began to rapidly dissolve.

"Indeed."

Time life forms were excited.

...

In the deepest part of Wanwei spacetime.

After Lin Yuan completely refined the Chaos Void, he gained insight into many of the essences of this top-tier dimensional space, and with his own accumulations, many bottlenecks that trapped him began to rapidly dissolve.

"Wrong," Innate Five Great "the direction of the third Tai is wrong."

Lin Yuan's eyes shone brightly, as early as fifty-five thousand years ago, he had founded 'Tai Shi' the second Tai of the 'Innate Five Great'.

'Innate Five Great' is the essence of Lin Yuan's life Tao Fruit, the first Tai is 'Tai Chu', and the second Tai is 'Tai Shi'.

After comprehending the first two Tai, Lin Yuan naturally wanted to extend and create the third Tai based on these two Tai.

But he never took that final step, vaguely sensing something wrong.

Now crossing into the Third Realm, becoming a Time Lord, his realm elevated, vision widened, and with the insights gained from refining the Chaos Void, he immediately discovered that the direction of the 'Innate Five Great' third Tai was problematic.

"The third Tai of the 'Innate Five Great' shouldn't be an extension of the first Tai and the second Tai, but their beginning."

Lin Yuan was radiant, "Or rather, this Tai is the true first Tai, and the original 'Tai Chu' and 'Tai Shi' are the second and third Tai."

Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, a brand new aura was born and condensed between his fingers.

"What I need to create should be the first Tai in the 'Innate Five Great', the true first Tai—Tai Yi."

In the depths of Lin Yuan's eyes, three kinds of auras interwoven continuously, representing the three Tai in the 'Innate Five Great', Tai Yi, Tai Chu, and Tai Shi.

"The fourth Tai..."

Lin Yuan began deducing the creation of the fourth Tai, resetting the order of the first three Tai in the 'Innate Five Great', Lin Yuan immediately sensed that the fourth Tai was not far away.

"Milky Way, congratulations." At this moment, the voice of the purple light Legendary Lord came.

Lin Yuan's timeline comprehensively sealed, crossing into the Third Realm, the transformations brought by himself, naturally could not be hidden from the Legendary Lords present.

However, the Legendary Lords did not immediately speak up to disturb him, waiting until Lin Yuan stabilized his own aura to offer their congratulations.

Lin Yuan looked up at the purple light Legendary Lord and smiled: "I was able to step into the Third Realm so quickly, thanks to your guidance."

Over the past 60,000 years of training, Lin Yuan often communicated with the Legendary Lords, and the purple light Legendary Lord provided Lin Yuan with much guidance.

"Even without me, you would have reached this point." The purple light Legendary Lord smiled.

"Milky Way, congratulations."

"Milky Way, congratulations on becoming a lord."

The voices of other Legendary Lords also came one by one to offer their congratulations.

All the Legendary Lords exhibited exceptional friendliness since Lin Yuan's future is terrifyingly significant. Naturally, if they could maintain a distance, they would maintain a distance, but if that wasn't possible, and they had to make contact, then they would show their utmost kindness and enthusiasm.

"Milky Way, how do you feel?"

The purple light Legendary Lord looked at Lin Yuan.

"After becoming a lord, I realized my insignificance..."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, crossing into the Third Realm; the transformation of his heart and will allowed him to directly perceive the existence of the supreme rule of the endless dimensional realm's awareness.

That is the power that runs through infinite dimensional realms, and even a Legendary Lord is insignificant before it.
